Title: [AA-001] Client: provision Meta Marketing API Sandbox Ad Account + token
Description:
As the client operator,
I want a Meta Marketing API Sandbox Ad Account and long-lived access token,
So that the agency can dogfood create_campaign without real ad spend.

## Context
Agency access model: client keeps production secrets and provisions sandbox credentials into a shared secure channel (not git). Generate token with ads_management, ads_read, business_management (+ pages scopes per Meta use-case docs). Sandbox: no payment method; ads do not deliver; Insights often empty.

## Deliver to agency (names only in git)
- META_APP_ID
- META_APP_SECRET (nice-to-have)
- META_ACCESS_TOKEN (long-lived / sandbox)
- META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID (digits only, no act_ prefix)
- Account currency (USD/INR/…)
- Confirmation: sandbox=yes

## Acceptance criteria
1. Given a Meta developer app with Marketing API, when sandbox ad account is created, then Ad Account ID is available without act_ prefix
2. Given token generation, when scopes include ads_management and ads_read, then Graph Explorer can call act_{id}
3. Given handoff, when agency receives credentials out-of-band, then no secrets appear in git commits
